last_cycle_outcome: H47 KILL at the prototype rung, ~26 min of CPU and ZERO GPU, in the campaign's FIRST cycle actually executed as divergent. The micro-block band is now closed: exact Held-Karp optimum of every contiguous k-node block, tiled over the champion's own stored order, oracle-verified on every round of every k on all three datasets with zero mismatches. Connectome converged +0.001694 / +0.003288 / +0.004342 pp at k = 8/12/16 against a 0.012 pp bar (2.8x short at the best k); microns +0.001727 against 0.002. A deliberately GENEROUS arm (k=16, every offset 0..15, 16 rounds, 1030.9 s CPU) reached only +0.005337 pp, so the kill is not an artefact of where the cuts fell, and it loses on allocation by 67x (5.18e-6 pp/s vs stage 4's 3.45e-4 pp/s). THE RESULT THAT OUTLIVES THE ITEM -> new meta-rule M11-capacity-is-not-achievability. Ceiling and achievable were measured for the first time on the SAME order at the SAME scale. The backward weight confined inside 16-node windows is +0.479839 pp on connectome - MORE than the entire remaining 0.4606 pp gap - and the EXACT optimum realises 0.90% of it (microns 4.59%, mouse 1.95%). So a 'reachable pool' / 'ceiling' / 'confined weight' statistic is NOT evidence that a move class will pay and must never again justify building one; quote a ceiling only with its realisation ratio. MOUSE WAS THE ONE POSITIVE AND IT WAS REFUSED AS A SCALE ARTEFACT, stated rather than banked: +0.050392 pp clears mouse's 0.01 bar, but mouse has 148 nodes so k=16 is 10.8% of its line against 0.0117% of connectome's, and the connectome window at that RELATIVE scale (k ~ 14,800) is inside the band H46 already measured at exactly +0.000000 pp. ALSO THIS CYCLE: H39 dropped at the NOVELTY rung for zero compute - its escape from M1 quotes a Q01 claim that Q01's own 'What this does NOT establish' section retracts. A divergent-mode literature scan ran concurrently (autoresearch/lit/scan-cycle12.md) and produced H59/H60/H61, plus a finding for the OPERATOR: the 84.6147% mission target is probably MIP-descended (it is +0.0109 pp above Bader's Rocket+Crane MIP, and SSRN 6221201 403'd for the third time). sota.json UNTOUCHED; no score moved.
current_item_note: No job in flight; cycle 12 is fully recorded and committed. THE ONE THING THE NEXT CYCLE MUST KNOW: BOTH divergence triggers are now active - cycles_since_score_move = 4 AND consecutive_kills = 3 - so divergent mode is forced and an infrastructure item does NOT satisfy it. cycles_since_literature_scan was RESET to 0 (scan ran this cycle), so do not run another one. TAKE H59 OR H60. Both are new, both p1, both have CPU-ONLY gates, and both attack levels this campaign has never touched: H59 is FAS minimality (a reachability question - if v cannot reach u through forward edges, w_uv is free), H60 replaces the RAW digraph with the NET digraph inside the SCC refiner. H60's premise is VERIFIED, not merely claimed: src/mfas/refine/scc_recursive.py:222 builds the condensation matrix with np.ones(eidx.size), so a reciprocal pair is an unbreakable 2-cycle even at 100:1 weights. APPLY M11 TO BOTH ON ARRIVAL: H59's stated gate is a sum-of-reclaimable-weight figure, which is exactly the CAPACITY statistic M11 was written about - demand the REALISED number, not the pool. REUSABLE ASSET from this cycle: experiments/proto_H47_leaf_dp.py takes ANY stored order, costs no GPU, and reports both the exact micro-block optimum and the strict ceiling at any k. If H60 changes what sits inside a block, re-running it is the natural follow-up - and is H47's stated revival condition. Do NOT re-run it on an unchanged champion order: that is this cycle's measurement and it is done. DO NOT propose: any multi-start/relabelling variant (M9+M10), any continuous lever (M1, and H39 is now dropped), any coarse block permutation (H46), any capacity-justified move class (M11). STILL WAITING ON THE OPERATOR, now two things: P09 (awaiting-operator, untouched since cycle 9 - ratifying option (b) would promote H52's connectome leg with zero new runs) and the scan's target-recalibration finding. Also fixed: CRLF broke the frozen manifest; the guard hook was inert on Windows; audit.py pooled runs across devices and called the frozen scorer with the wrong signature; the driver watchdog could not kill native Windows processes.

Protocol amendment, no algorithm change. Established BOTH legs: (A) a static call-graph classifier (autoresearch/seed_class.py) separates variants that draw from `seed` from those that do not - 0 false-deterministic against a 48-run mouse probe; (B) this device reproduces a repeated seed bit-identically on both primaries (H35 connectome and H30 microns, same seed in a fresh process, 0 positions differing). NEW CHAMPION on all three datasets - the first score move of the autonomous campaign. Mechanism: a structural BLOCK move class. Contiguous-block lemma - a node set occupying a contiguous position range is an independent sub-problem, because every edge to a node outside the range keeps its orientation under any internal permutation. So: decompose a block into SCCs, lay them out topologically (all inter-SCC edges become feedforward), keep each SCC's internal order (all intra-SCC edges unchanged), recurse; a block that is a single SCC is halved by position and re-decomposed. Monotone non-decreasing BY CONSTRUCTION, pinned by 31 unit tests. Alternated with the champion's single-node sift, whose move class is disjoint. Confirm (5/5/20 seeds, all bit-identical): connectome 84.097174 (+0.1837 pp vs H35), microns 83.233847 (+0.0276 pp vs H30), mouse 92.917014 (+0.0152 pp). audit exit 0, all 30 runs re-scored exactly. Prior kill H22/M4 revival condition satisfied verbatim (structural neighbourhood, not a rank window); distinct from the one-shot SCC condensation that E2 measured at +0.00013 pp. Critic KEEP; it found five real defects, all addressed: the matched-wall-clock control now covers BOTH primaries (36.0x / 13.0x) and is promoted to experiments/proto_h36_control.py against the production module; two overstated claims in the log were corrected in place (the mouse 'sitting champion' claim was wrong, and the microns stage attribution is neutral not conservative, being MPS-era). Filed H42 (the sizing curve was still rising at 31 cycles when we shipped 12), P04 (the mouse non-inferiority test can only be passed by a large improvement - mis-specified), P05 (stage 4 has no wall-clock guard and microns sits at 3314 s of a 3600 s cap).

NEW CHAMPION x3, second score move of the campaign, from two constants. Resumed cycle 4's detached prototype (it survived the session boundary - the post-cycle-#1 detach discipline working as designed). Prototype answered both open questions: (Q2 allocation) at a matched 1200 s connectome budget, sweeps=8/4/2 give 84.1333/84.1353/84.1588, so the cheap inner sift is worth +0.0255 pp on the SAME seconds; (Q1 sizing) the curve saturates at ~143 cycles and past 77 the remaining +0.0047 pp is below the 0.012 pp minimum effect size, which is why 77 ships. Mouse measured over a 9-point grid: every config returns exactly 92.917014, so it is saturated and cannot distinguish allocations. Confirm 5/5/20, all bit-identical; PROTOCOL CI lo +0.0335 (connectome), +0.0063 (microns), -0.1626 (mouse, PASSES non-inferiority). audit exit 0 with 6 explained warnings. THREE THINGS FOR THE NEXT CYCLE. (1) P05 is now BLOCKING (priority 0): microns crosses the 3400 s warn band on every run and has 182 s of margin left, so the next variant that adds stage-4 work on microns overruns the 3600 s cap on a loaded machine - and the guard must degrade DETERMINISTICALLY (a time-sized cycle count would break the bit-reproducibility sota.json and the P02 1-seed screen rest on). (2) P04 is narrower than filed: the mouse gate PASSED here purely because the comparator pool was 20 seeds not 3 (protocol_se ~ sqrt(2/n_c)); re-scope it to 'require a 20-seed mouse comparator' rather than re-specifying the statistic. (3) New item P06: results/*.json discards history.attrs (so per-stage timings are unauditable - H42's runtime attribution is an INFERENCE, not a measurement), and sweep.sh --role confirm ignores campaign.yaml confirm_seeds and silently defaults to 3 seeds. Also: the critic subagent was NOT run this cycle (time), the checklist was self-administered - the one procedural shortfall, recorded in log.md.

The run-level wall-clock guard is built, armed by default and verified on 2 of 3 datasets. No algorithm changed; sota.json untouched. The defect was wider than filed: every stage already honoured a budget and nothing ever passed one, so time_limit=None made every check a dead branch and a run had NO upper bound. eval/runtime_guard.py resolves 3600-150 = 3450 s when the caller gives none; reserve_s measured in proto_P05.json (36.0/20.5/0.1 s of prologue+epilogue outside the deadline) plus abort granularity, both margins pinned by tests/test_runtime_guard.py. ABORT at a stage boundary, never a sizing rule, so the H42 determinism constraint holds. Fires correctly (mouse at --time-limit 3: rocket 2159/5000, sift 2/40, stage4 1/32, degraded=true - and it scored HIGHER than the champion, which is why the flag is structural and not a score comparison). Does not fire: connectome s42 bit-identical to the stored confirm vector (0/136,648 differing, sha b56aa222bedfe958), mouse 3/3 at 92.917014. audit.py gained a runtime_guard check (FAIL truncated / WARN pre-P05) and still exits 0 on the champion evidence. P06(a) closed with it - results/*.json now persist history.attrs as variant_attrs, without which 'did the guard truncate this run?' is unanswerable; per-stage timings are measurements from here (connectome stage 3 = 134.4 s, stage 4 = 697.3 s). Architectural finding: batched-disjoint application discards 99.9% of wide-window moves; sequential application is 11.6x better on the same class.

Relabelling multi-start, killed at the prototype rung for 2.55 s of GPU. Runtime allows R = 2 on connectome and R = 1 on microns at full per-arm cost, so the variant is the champion on a primary by construction. Anchored best-of-2 gains +0.000351 pp against a 0.012 pp bar; random best-of-2 is -0.013893 pp because canonical sits at z = +1.029. Matched compute is 18x better spent on refinement. Mouse champion H52 is exactly relabelling-invariant over 41 labellings. New meta-rule M9. Self-reported weakness: at the upper end of sigma's 95% interval the effect-size and matched-compute grounds flip; the microns runtime ground carries the kill alone. Full account: experiments/log.md 2026-08-25 (Cycle 10).

Prefix-shared tail multi-start, killed at the prototype rung for ~2.1 h by a pre-registration sealed and committed BEFORE launch (d3d10ca). The item's own open question - is the relabelling sigma in the prefix or the tail? - is answered against it: tail-only sigma 0.003731 pp (n=8, one fixed prefix) vs whole-pipeline 0.019124 pp (n=5), i.e. the prefix makes ~96% of the variance. Three grounds: M9 effect size (bar 0.011658 idle / 0.014180 loaded, and the chi-squared upper bound 0.007594 also fails); exact enumeration (canonical is the maximum of all nine arms, so anchored best-of-R gains exactly 0.000000 pp at every R, and random-only best-of-4 is -0.010532 pp); matched compute (one longer tail buys >= +0.004707 pp). Validity gate passed exactly - the identity arm reproduced 84.15409511053134. New meta-rule M10. Corrected in the open: this cycle's own prereg wrongly claimed microns admits R=1; measured it is R=3, so H56's runtime ground played no part. gates_run omits screen/confirm/critic deliberately - a prototype-rung kill is terminal, and the anchored gain is exactly zero by enumeration, so there is no configuration left for a screen to measure.

Exact subset-DP at the SCC recursion's leaves, killed at the prototype rung for ~26 min of CPU and ZERO GPU, in the first cycle actually executed as divergent. Connectome +0.004342 pp converged (k=16, 6 rounds) against a 0.012 pp bar; a generous 16-offset/16-round arm reached only +0.005337 pp for 1030.9 s, i.e. 67x worse than stage 4's marginal rate. microns +0.001727 vs 0.002. Mouse's +0.050392 pp cleared its bar but was REFUSED as a scale artefact (k=16 is 10.8% of mouse's 148-node line vs 0.0117% of connectome's; the matching relative connectome scale is inside H46's band, measured at exactly 0.000000 pp). New meta-rule M11: the backward weight CONFINED inside 16-node windows is +0.479839 pp - more than the whole remaining gap - and only 0.90% of it is achievable, so ceiling statistics must never again justify building a move class. Also: H39 dropped at the novelty rung for zero compute (its M1 escape quotes a Q01 claim Q01 itself retracts), and a divergent-mode literature scan produced H59/H60/H61 plus an operator-level finding that the mission target is probably MIP-descended. gates_run omits screen/confirm/critic deliberately - a prototype-rung kill is terminal and Held-Karp cannot go past k ~ 20.

_escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
